name: OceanX Tri-Domain Showcase
description: A repeatable presentation sequence for an air, surface, and underwater OceanX scenario.
operator_cues: When the UE window appears, press 2 for Chase view.
Press Tab to cycle UAV, USV, and underwater vehicles; press P for multi-view, I for telemetry, and M for the top-down trajectory map.
Press F10 at the start if you want UE authoritative Replay in addition to the ROS bag.
Press Ctrl+F9 during the final act to save top-down and per-vehicle capture boards.

acts.name: Opening
acts.message: OceanX is starting a tri-domain scene. Prepare Chase view, telemetry HUD, multi-view, and trajectory map.

acts.name: Air domain
acts.message: Show X500, StandardVTOL, and RCCessna as three airframe profiles sharing the same scene, timing, and telemetry graph.

acts.name: Surface domain
acts.message: Show the WAM-V as the stable surface command and RF/acoustic gateway for the underwater team.

acts.name: Underwater companion assets
acts.message: Use Tab or multi-view to show LAUV, Desistek, and RexROV2 as additional underwater vehicle profiles in the same synchronized runtime.

acts.name: Tri-domain profile contrast
acts.message: Switch vehicles with Tab and show all eight shipped UAV, VTOL, fixed-wing, USV, AUV, and ROV profiles in one synchronized OceanX runtime.

acts.name: Capture board
acts.message: Press Ctrl+F9 now to save the tri-domain top-down trajectory and per-vehicle multi-view capture boards.

acts.name: Replay close
acts.message: Press F10 again to stop UE Replay recording. The director will close the ROS bag automatically.
